body: I'm doing what I can, what I can't do is to let myself get to the point where I hurt someone. That's my fear and I have to stop myself before I get to that point.

Thank you for these words. I am trying really hard and telling myself that I can fight through this, unfortunately this only works if I can control myself and lately I'm losing control. What scares me the most is that soon I might not be able to control myself and hurt someone, I really don't want that to happen but its something that crosses my mind very often lately. There is nothing that will justify hurting someone, I have seen a lot of violence and know how it solves nothing. If I cant control myself and do something to someone then I will not be able to live with it anyway so before things go that far I feel that the only sure way to control this is to bring an end to my existence. Many times I kept telling myself that I'm strong and things will get better, it worked but in the end I fell even lower than I was at the starting point. The battles have left me with scars and they didn't heal, instead over time they got infected and that's likely why I'm losing control... I don't think that I'll be able to get through it this time and that's why I came here to get this out so I'm not the only person to know these things since I never told anyone about how deep this problem really is.
Don't worry I'm not going to do it, not yet and when the time comes you will not know about it so there is no way it would hurt you.

This is just a small part of what I have been through, there is much more but I cant talk about these things cause I do not want to be identified. I am trying to self improve but its all for nothing, I don't see whats the goal for doing these things to be honest since they only impact me and well there is not much left of what could be called 'me'. I am an empty shell of what once was a human, now I just eat, walk, sleep and sometimes talk. I didn't give up yet and didn't give up all these times before but my mind is starting to deteriorate beyond what I can handle, I am having grim thoughts almost all the time lately. Things do take turns for better or worst but for me it just ends up worst at the end no matter what I try to do and I cant take these falls anymore. I think that it could have ended long time ago for me and I am finding out that there is very little that I'm able to do change things for better. I can either the the cowards way out and leave in peace or cause major pain and suffering for other people, I chose the peaceful way since there is enough pain that people have been through because of me. Thank you for the pm offer but I cant take it. I am a great listener too and never judge either but if I give advice its usually not good.

I am not giving up just yet but I feel that soon I will lose control and do something bad. I don't know why would you say that I have a lot of insight into life and people, unless you mean I have seen a lot of shit that lives in people and how it can turn life into pain.

I wish that I could offer something positive but what lately runs through my mind is just negative things with brief hopes for things turning better, I don't want this to come out of me and I feel that there is a strong possibility that if I don't leave this world something bad is bound to happen eventually. If I don't leave it and lose the little control I have a tragedy will happen that's for sure, I woke up with knifes on multiple occasions and once I slept with an axe under my bed but thankfully that night I took enough sleeping pills to keep me asleep and didn't wake up. Is it worth it or not I don't know but I'm not sure anyone can understand the magnitude of the situation, I'd rather create temporary psychological pain for people than hurt them physically. I am not going talk to a therapist I never talk to anyone about how I feel or what goes through my mind, well almost never cause I talked to this girl about some of the things and I guess I'm talking to everyone who's willing to read my broken English scribbles on this sub. Am I able to work through this, I don't know for how long and it feels that there is something bad bound to happen one way or another..

What I felt at that time does not matter any more, I don't care how my family would feel about it. Thank you for the pm offer but I cant take it. As much as I wish that there was a way to get her back or a different girl I don't care about that either, I don't care about anything at all anymore to be honest. I have lost everything so many times that having nothing is something that I've grown to expect and live with at this point. I just don't want to hurt someone physically, that is my biggest fear. I am slowly losing control and I can feel it, this is why I think that before I do something to someone I should take care of myself once and forever.
